scope: exact permitted B4 30-document development sample only

inputs.official_tokens: Python str.split; token indices are zero-based half-open; source character offsets are zero-based Unicode-code-point half-open from uzh_rsd.tokens.tokenize
inputs.punctuation: gold -1 positions excluded exactly as official evaluator; selectors never see this mask

stage_a.budget: five non-overlapping radius-2 official-token regions per document across both sides; clipped at boundaries
stage_a.A0: byte-exact first five groups from frozen B5 suspicious_v1 routing
stage_a.A1: risk-atlas routing: .60 risk + .25 B4 alignment confidence + .10 structural cue + .05 anomaly; explicitly permits high-confidence/low-anomaly risk regions
stage_a.A2: A1 plus .15 structured family agreement, with rebalanced fixed coefficients; agreement only for exact DE/FR/IT sibling sets whose shared English text hash and official tokens are identical, and only categories occurring on English plus every target side
controls: equal-budget SHA-256 uniform_random with seed b6-risk-atlas-random-v1
stage_a.eligibility: all official token positions; evaluation later removes official -1 mask
stage_a.failure: fail closed; no gold-based backfill, query, reranking, or repair
stage_a.failed_gate: verdict NOT SUPPORTED; zero Apertus calls; Stage B and C prohibited

stage_b_if_authorized.acceptance: at least 90% valid one-token responses, at least 0.85 semantic stability under each permutation, balanced accuracy at least 0.70 on synthetic controls, and at least +0.10 over best deterministic control

stage_c_if_authorized.update: promote selected official-token B4 score by clipped 0.20 * P(materially different) only when P1-P0 >= 0.25; otherwise unchanged
stage_c_if_authorized.attribution: actual minus shuffled and lexicon controls
stage_c_if_authorized.unselected: byte-identical B4 numeric values and order

test_split: refuse before path construction or I/O; no test path, metadata, or content may be listed or inspected
